query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']) AND n.granularity='item' WITH count(n) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN exists((n)-[:definedInSection]->(:Section)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked RETURN CASE WHEN total=0 THEN null ELSE total=linked END AS allLinked
